notes: Except Product_Master.csv, Business_Units.csv and Locations.csv, the dataset is modeled/synthetic training data anchored to public products/prices; findings are decision-dashboard evidence, not audited company facts.
Alert files are rewritten in full on every run.
Discount floor rule is disclosed in discount_floor_breach.csv.
stockout_new.csv uses Stockout_Days_In_Month > 0; closing_stock_zero is a separate boolean column.
overstock_watch.csv uses Days_of_Cover > 180 after the addendum decision; cover band also separates >365 days.
Stockout and overstock use location x product x month inventory grain.
